facts.text: A tire model is a formula or table giving the forward, braking and sideways force a tire produces for a given load, slip and surface; tire-soil interaction covers the case where ground deforms under the tire.
facts.quote: A tire model is a formula or table that gives the forward, braking and sideways force a tire produces for a given load, slip and surface; tire-soil interaction is the harder case where the ground deforms under the tire.

facts.text: The tire-model families named in the booklet include Fiala, a simple physical model; Magic Formula, also called Pacejka, an empirical curve fitted to test data and widely used for road vehicles; and TMeasy.
facts.quote: Fiala, a simple physical model; the Magic Formula, also called Pacejka, an empirical curve fitted to test data and widely used for road vehicles; and TMeasy [Chapters 8, 11].

facts.text: The articulated-loader studies cited in the booklet used Fiala tire models.
facts.quote: The articulated-loader studies the booklet cites used Fiala tires [Chapter 8].

facts.text: Fiala, Magic Formula (Pacejka) and TMeasy tire models assume a firm surface.
facts.quote: These models assume a firm surface.

facts.text: A 2023 soil-wheel model covering all slip and skid states predicted forces well in sand.
facts.quote: A 2023 soil-wheel model covering all slip and skid states predicted forces well in sand

facts.text: Some tuning parameters of the 2023 soil-wheel model covering all slip and skid states changed with slip angle.
facts.quote: A 2023 soil-wheel model covering all slip and skid states predicted forces well in sand, but some of its tuning parameters changed with slip angle

facts.text: A 2026 soil-wheel model shows soil building up in front of the wheel during braking.
facts.quote: a 2026 model shows soil building up in front of the wheel during braking [Chapter 8].

facts.text: Developers of at least one unnamed open-source tool report that its handling tire models do not work with deformable terrain; only rigid or finite-element tires and tracked vehicles do.
facts.quote: In at least one open-source tool, the developers report that the handling tire models do not work with deformable terrain at all; only rigid or finite-element tires and tracked vehicles do [Chapter 11].

facts.text: Tire parameters for unpaved ground must be fitted from tests on the real machine rather than copied from road-car values.
facts.quote: Tire parameters on unpaved ground must be fitted from tests on the real machine; they cannot be copied from road-car values [Chapter 8].

facts.text: The booklet identifies the tire-ground interface as one of the places where simple models fail.
facts.quote: The booklet counts the tire-ground interface among the places where simple models fail

facts.text: The booklet recommends a low-speed friction matrix covering hard, loose and wet conditions for each machine family rather than a site-by-site soil survey.
facts.quote: recommends a low-speed friction matrix (hard, loose, wet) per machine family rather than a site-by-site soil survey [Chapter 8].
